15	object PoTokenProviderImpl : PoTokenProvider {
16	    val TAG = PoTokenProviderImpl::class.simpleName
17	    private val webViewSupported by lazy { DeviceUtils.supportsWebView() }
18	    private var webViewBadImpl = false // whether the system has a bad WebView implementation
19	
20	    private object WebPoTokenGenLock
21	    private var webPoTokenVisitorData: String? = null
22	    private var webPoTokenStreamingPot: String? = null
23	    private var webPoTokenGenerator: PoTokenGenerator? = null
24	
25	    override fun getWebClientPoToken(videoId: String): PoTokenResult? {
26	        if (!webViewSupported || webViewBadImpl) {
27	            return null
28	        }
29	
30	        try {
31	            return getWebClientPoToken(videoId = videoId, forceRecreate = false)
32	        } catch (e: RuntimeException) {
33	            // RxJava's Single wraps exceptions into RuntimeErrors, so we need to unwrap them here
34	            when (val cause = e.cause) {
35	                is BadWebViewException -> {
36	                    Log.e(TAG, "Could not obtain poToken because WebView is broken", e)
37	                    webViewBadImpl = true
38	                    return null
39	                }
40	
41	                null -> throw e
42	
43	                else -> throw cause // includes PoTokenException
44	            }
45	        }
46	    }
47	
48	    /**
49	     * @param forceRecreate whether to force the recreation of [webPoTokenGenerator], to be used in
50	     * case the current [webPoTokenGenerator] threw an error last time
51	     * [PoTokenGenerator.generatePoToken] was called
52	     */
53	    private fun getWebClientPoToken(videoId: String, forceRecreate: Boolean): PoTokenResult {
54	        // just a helper class since Kotlin does not have builtin support for 4-tuples
55	        data class Quadruple<T1, T2, T3, T4>(val t1: T1, val t2: T2, val t3: T3, val t4: T4)
56	
57	        val (poTokenGenerator, visitorData, streamingPot, hasBeenRecreated) =
58	            synchronized(WebPoTokenGenLock) {
59	                val shouldRecreate = webPoTokenGenerator == null || forceRecreate ||
60	                    webPoTokenGenerator!!.isExpired()
61	
62	                if (shouldRecreate) {
63	                    val innertubeClientRequestInfo = InnertubeClientRequestInfo.ofWebClient()
64	                    innertubeClientRequestInfo.clientInfo.clientVersion =
65	                        YoutubeParsingHelper.getClientVersion()
66	
67	                    webPoTokenVisitorData = YoutubeParsingHelper.getVisitorDataFromInnertube(
68	                        innertubeClientRequestInfo,
69	                        NewPipe.getPreferredLocalization(),
70	                        NewPipe.getPreferredContentCountry(),
71	                        YoutubeParsingHelper.getYouTubeHeaders(),
72	                        YoutubeParsingHelper.YOUTUBEI_V1_URL,
73	                        null,
74	                        false
75	                    )
76	                    // close the current webPoTokenGenerator on the main thread
77	                    webPoTokenGenerator?.let { Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).post { it.close() } }
78	
79	                    // create a new webPoTokenGenerator
80	                    webPoTokenGenerator = PoTokenWebView
81	                        .newPoTokenGenerator(App.instance).blockingGet()
82	
83	                    // The streaming poToken needs to be generated exactly once before generating
84	                    // any other (player) tokens.
85	                    webPoTokenStreamingPot = webPoTokenGenerator!!
86	                        .generatePoToken(webPoTokenVisitorData!!).blockingGet()
87	                }
88	
89	                return@synchronized Quadruple(
90	                    webPoTokenGenerator!!,
91	                    webPoTokenVisitorData!!,
92	                    webPoTokenStreamingPot!!,
93	                    shouldRecreate
94	                )
95	            }
96	
97	        val playerPot = try {
98	            // Not using synchronized here, since poTokenGenerator would be able to generate
99	            // multiple poTokens in parallel if needed. The only important thing is for exactly one
100	            // visitorData/streaming poToken to be generated before anything else.
101	            poTokenGenerator.generatePoToken(videoId).blockingGet()
102	        } catch (throwable: Throwable) {
103	            if (hasBeenRecreated) {
104	                // the poTokenGenerator has just been recreated (and possibly this is already the
105	                // second time we try), so there is likely nothing we can do
106	                throw throwable
107	            } else {
108	                // retry, this time recreating the [webPoTokenGenerator] from scratch;
109	                // this might happen for example if NewPipe goes in the background and the WebView
110	                // content is lost
111	                Log.e(TAG, "Failed to obtain poToken, retrying", throwable)
112	                return getWebClientPoToken(videoId = videoId, forceRecreate = true)
113	            }
114	        }
115	
116	        if (BuildConfig.DEBUG) {
117	            Log.d(
118	                TAG,
119	                "poToken for $videoId: playerPot=$playerPot, " +
120	                    "streamingPot=$streamingPot, visitor_data=$visitorData"
121	            )
122	        }
123	
124	        return PoTokenResult(visitorData, playerPot, streamingPot)
125	    }
126	}

package org.schabi.newpipe.util.potoken

import android.content.Context
import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Single
import java.io.Closeable

/**
 * This interface was created to allow for multiple methods to generate poTokens in the future (e.g.
 * via WebView and via a local DOM implementation)
 */
interface PoTokenGenerator : Closeable {
    /**
     * Generates a poToken for the provided identifier, using the `integrityToken` and
     * `webPoSignalOutput` previously obtained in the initialization of [PoTokenWebView]. Can be
     * called multiple times.
     */
    fun generatePoToken(identifier: String): Single<String>

    /**
     * @return whether the `integrityToken` is expired, in which case all tokens generated by
     * [generatePoToken] will be invalid
     */
    fun isExpired(): Boolean

    interface Factory {
        /**
         * Initializes a [PoTokenGenerator] by loading the BotGuard VM, running it, and obtaining
         * an `integrityToken`. Can then be used multiple times to generate multiple poTokens with
         * [generatePoToken].
         *
         * @param context used e.g. to load the HTML asset or to instantiate a WebView
         */
        fun newPoTokenGenerator(context: Context): Single<PoTokenGenerator>
    }
}

23	class PoTokenWebView private constructor(
24	    context: Context,
25	    // to be used exactly once only during initialization!
26	    private val generatorEmitter: SingleEmitter<PoTokenGenerator>
27	) : PoTokenGenerator {
28	    private val webView = WebView(context)
29	    private val disposables = CompositeDisposable() // used only during initialization
30	    private val poTokenEmitters = mutableListOf<Pair<String, SingleEmitter<String>>>()
31	    private lateinit var expirationInstant: Instant
32	
33	    //region Initialization
34	    init {
35	        val webViewSettings = webView.settings
36	        //noinspection SetJavaScriptEnabled we want to use JavaScript!
37	        webViewSettings.javaScriptEnabled = true
38	        if (WebViewFeature.isFeatureSupported(WebViewFeature.SAFE_BROWSING_ENABLE)) {
39	            WebSettingsCompat.setSafeBrowsingEnabled(webViewSettings, false)
40	        }
41	        webViewSettings.userAgentString = USER_AGENT
42	        webViewSettings.blockNetworkLoads = true // the WebView does not need internet access
43	
44	        // so that we can run async functions and get back the result
45	        webView.addJavascriptInterface(this, JS_INTERFACE)
46	
47	        webView.webChromeClient = object : WebChromeClient() {
48	            override fun onConsoleMessage(m: ConsoleMessage): Boolean {
49	                if (m.message().contains("Uncaught")) {
50	                    // There should not be any uncaught errors while executing the code, because
51	                    // everything that can fail is guarded by try-catch. Therefore, this likely
52	                    // indicates that there was a syntax error in the code, i.e. the WebView only
53	                    // supports a really old version of JS.
54	
55	                    val fmt = "\"${m.message()}\", source: ${m.sourceId()} (${m.lineNumber()})"
56	                    val exception = BadWebViewException(fmt)
57	                    Log.e(TAG, "This WebView implementation is broken: $fmt")
58	
59	                    onInitializationErrorCloseAndCancel(exception)
60	                    popAllPoTokenEmitters().forEach { (_, emitter) -> emitter.onError(exception) }
61	                }
62	                return super.onConsoleMessage(m)
63	            }
64	        }
65	    }
66	
67	    /**
68	     * Must be called right after instantiating [PoTokenWebView] to perform the actual
69	     * initialization. This will asynchronously go through all the steps needed to load BotGuard,
70	     * run it, and obtain an `integrityToken`.
71	     */
72	    private fun loadHtmlAndObtainBotguard(context: Context) {
73	        if (BuildConfig.DEBUG) {
74	            Log.d(TAG, "loadHtmlAndObtainBotguard() called")
75	        }
76	
77	        disposables.add(
78	            Single.fromCallable {
79	                val html = context.assets.open("po_token.html").bufferedReader()
80	                    .use { it.readText() }
81	                return@fromCallable html
82	            }
83	                .subscribeOn(Schedulers.io())
84	                .observeOn(AndroidSchedulers.mainThread())
85	                .subscribe(
86	                    { html ->
87	                        webView.loadDataWithBaseURL(
88	                            "https://www.youtube.com",
89	                            html.replaceFirst(
90	                                "</script>",
91	                                // calls downloadAndRunBotguard() when the page has finished loading
92	                                "\n$JS_INTERFACE.downloadAndRunBotguard()</script>"
93	                            ),
94	                            "text/html",
95	                            "utf-8",
96	                            null
97	                        )
98	                    },
99	                    this::onInitializationErrorCloseAndCancel
100	                )
101	        )
102	    }
103	
104	    /**
105	     * Called during initialization by the JavaScript snippet appended to the HTML page content in
106	     * [loadHtmlAndObtainBotguard] after the WebView content has been loaded.
107	     */
108	    @JavascriptInterface
109	    fun downloadAndRunBotguard() {
110	        if (BuildConfig.DEBUG) {
111	            Log.d(TAG, "downloadAndRunBotguard() called")
112	        }
113	
114	        makeBotguardServiceRequest(
115	            "https://www.youtube.com/api/jnn/v1/Create",
116	            "[ \"$REQUEST_KEY\" ]"
117	        ) { responseBody ->
118	            val parsedChallengeData = parseChallengeData(responseBody)
119	            webView.evaluateJavascript(
120	                """try {
121	                    data = $parsedChallengeData
122	                    runBotGuard(data).then(function (result) {
123	                        this.webPoSignalOutput = result.webPoSignalOutput
124	                        $JS_INTERFACE.onRunBotguardResult(result.botguardResponse)
125	                    }, function (error) {
126	                        $JS_INTERFACE.onJsInitializationError(error + "\n" + error.stack)
127	                    })
128	                } catch (error) {
129	                    $JS_INTERFACE.onJsInitializationError(error + "\n" + error.stack)
130	                }""",
131	                null
132	            )
133	        }
134	    }
135	
136	    /**
137	     * Called during initialization by the JavaScript snippets from either
138	     * [downloadAndRunBotguard] or [onRunBotguardResult].
139	     */
140	    @JavascriptInterface
141	    fun onJsInitializationError(error: String) {
142	        if (BuildConfig.DEBUG) {
143	            Log.e(TAG, "Initialization error from JavaScript: $error")
144	        }
145	        onInitializationErrorCloseAndCancel(buildExceptionForJsError(error))
146	    }
147	
148	    /**
149	     * Called during initialization by the JavaScript snippet from [downloadAndRunBotguard] after
150	     * obtaining the BotGuard execution output [botguardResponse].
151	     */
152	    @JavascriptInterface
153	    fun onRunBotguardResult(botguardResponse: String) {
154	        if (BuildConfig.DEBUG) {
155	            Log.d(TAG, "botguardResponse: $botguardResponse")
156	        }
157	        makeBotguardServiceRequest(
158	            "https://www.youtube.com/api/jnn/v1/GenerateIT",
159	            "[ \"$REQUEST_KEY\", \"$botguardResponse\" ]"
160	        ) { responseBody ->
161	            if (BuildConfig.DEBUG) {
162	                Log.d(TAG, "GenerateIT response: $responseBody")
163	            }
164	            val (integrityToken, expirationTimeInSeconds) = parseIntegrityTokenData(responseBody)
165	
166	            // leave 10 minutes of margin just to be sure
167	            expirationInstant = Instant.now().plusSeconds(expirationTimeInSeconds - 600)
168	
169	            webView.evaluateJavascript(
170	                "this.integrityToken = $integrityToken"
171	            ) {
172	                if (BuildConfig.DEBUG) {
173	                    Log.d(TAG, "initialization finished, expiration=${expirationTimeInSeconds}s")
174	                }
175	                generatorEmitter.onSuccess(this)
176	            }
177	        }
178	    }
179	    //endregion
180	
181	    //region Obtaining poTokens
182	    override fun generatePoToken(identifier: String): Single<String> = Single.create { emitter ->
183	        if (BuildConfig.DEBUG) {
184	            Log.d(TAG, "generatePoToken() called with identifier $identifier")
185	        }
186	        runOnMainThread(emitter) {
187	            addPoTokenEmitter(identifier, emitter)
188	            val u8Identifier = stringToU8(identifier)
189	            webView.evaluateJavascript(
190	                """try {
191	                        identifier = "$identifier"
192	                        u8Identifier = $u8Identifier
193	                        poTokenU8 = obtainPoToken(webPoSignalOutput, integrityToken, u8Identifier)
194	                        poTokenU8String = ""
195	                        for (i = 0; i < poTokenU8.length; i++) {
196	                            if (i != 0) poTokenU8String += ","
197	                            poTokenU8String += poTokenU8[i]
198	                        }
199	                        $JS_INTERFACE.onObtainPoTokenResult(identifier, poTokenU8String)
200	                    } catch (error) {
201	                        $JS_INTERFACE.onObtainPoTokenError(identifier, error + "\n" + error.stack)
202	                    }"""
203	            ) {}
204	        }

    const val DB_VER_3 = 3

    private val isDebug = MainActivity.DEBUG

    val MIGRATION_1_2 = Migration(DB_VER_1, DB_VER_2) { connection ->

            Log.d(TAG, "Start migrating database")
        }

        /*
         * Unfortunately these queries must be hardcoded due to the possibility of
         * schema and names changing at a later date, thus invalidating the older migration
         * scripts if they are not hardcoded.
         * */

        // Not much we can do about this, since room doesn't create tables before migration.
        // It's either this or blasting the entire database anew.
        connection.execSQL(
            "CREATE  INDEX `index_search_history_search` " +
                "ON `search_history` (`search`)"
        )
        connection.execSQL(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `streams` " +
                "(`uid` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, " +
                "`service_id` INTEGER NOT NULL, `url` TEXT, `title` TEXT, " +
                "`stream_type` TEXT, `duration` INTEGER, `uploader` TEXT, " +
                "`thumbnail_url` TEXT)"
        )
        connection.execSQL(
            "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `index_streams_service_id_url` " +
                "ON `streams` (`service_id`, `url`)"
        )
        connection.execSQL(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `stream_history` " +
                "(`stream_id` INTEGER NOT NULL, `access_date` INTEGER NOT NULL, " +
                "`repeat_count` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`stream_id`, `access_date`), " +
                "FOREIGN KEY(`stream_id`) REFERENCES `streams`(`uid`) " +
                "ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE )"
        )
        connection.execSQL(
            "CREATE  INDEX `index_stream_history_stream_id` " +
                "ON `stream_history` (`stream_id`)"
        )
        connection.execSQL(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `stream_state` " +
                "(`stream_id` INTEGER NOT NULL, `progress_time` INTEGER NOT NULL, " +
                "PRIMARY KEY(`stream_id`), FOREIGN KEY(`stream_id`) " +
                "REFERENCES `streams`(`uid`) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE )"
        )
        connection.execSQL(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `playlists` " +
                "(`uid` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, " +
                "`name` TEXT, `thumbnail_url` TEXT)"
        )
        connection.execSQL("CREATE  INDEX `index_playlists_name` ON `playlists` (`name`)")
        connection.execSQL(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `playlist_stream_join` " +
                "(`playlist_id` INTEGER NOT NULL, `stream_id` INTEGER NOT NULL, " +
                "`join_index` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`playlist_id`, `join_index`), " +
                "FOREIGN KEY(`playlist_id`) REFERENCES `playlists`(`uid`) " +
                "ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, " +
                "FOREIGN KEY(`stream_id`) REFERENCES `streams`(`uid`) " +
                "ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)"
        )
        connection.execSQL(
            "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX " +
                "`index_playlist_stream_join_playlist_id_join_index` " +
                "ON `playlist_stream_join` (`playlist_id`, `join_index`)"
        )
        connection.execSQL(
            "CREATE  INDEX `index_playlist_stream_join_stream_id` " +
                "ON `playlist_stream_join` (`stream_id`)"
        )
        connection.execSQL(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `remote_playlists` " +
                "(`uid` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, " +
                "`service_id` INTEGER NOT NULL, `name` TEXT, `url` TEXT, " +
                "`thumbnail_url` TEXT, `uploader` TEXT, `stream_count` INTEGER)"
        )
        connection.execSQL(

                "ON `remote_playlists` (`name`)"
        )
        connection.execSQL(
            "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `index_remote_playlists_service_id_url` " +
                "ON `remote_playlists` (`service_id`, `url`)"
        )

        // Populate streams table with existing entries in watch history
        // Latest data first, thus ignoring older entries with the same indices
        connection.execSQL(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO streams (service_id, url, title, " +
                "stream_type, duration, uploader, thumbnail_url) " +

                "SELECT service_id, url, title, 'VIDEO_STREAM', duration, " +
                "uploader, thumbnail_url " +

                "FROM watch_history " +
                "ORDER BY creation_date DESC"
        )

        // Once the streams have PKs, join them with the normalized history table
        // and populate it with the remaining data from watch history
        connection.execSQL(
            "INSERT INTO stream_history (stream_id, access_date, repeat_count)" +
                "SELECT uid, creation_date, 1 " +
                "FROM watch_history INNER JOIN streams " +
                "ON watch_history.service_id == streams.service_id " +
                "AND watch_history.url == streams.url " +
                "ORDER BY creation_date DESC"
        )

        connection.execSQL("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS watch_history")

        if (isDebug) {
            Log.d(TAG, "Stop migrating database")
        }
    }

                "ifnull(uploader, ''), ifnull(thumbnail_url, ''), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL " +

        connection.execSQL("ALTER TABLE streams_new RENAME TO streams")
        connection.execSQL(

        // Tables for feed feature

                "PRIMARY KEY(stream_id, subscription_id), " +
                "FOREIGN KEY(stream_id) REFERENCES streams(uid) " +

        connection.execSQL(

                "(group_id INTEGER NOT NULL, subscription_id INTEGER NOT NULL, " +
                "PRIMARY KEY(group_id, subscription_id), " +
                "FOREIGN KEY(group_id) REFERENCES feed_group(uid) " +
                "ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, " +
                "FOREIGN KEY(subscription_id) REFERENCES subscriptions(uid) " +
                "ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)"
        )
        connection.execSQL(
            "CREATE INDEX index_feed_group_subscription_join_subscription_id " +
                "ON feed_group_subscription_join (subscription_id)"
        )
        connection.execSQL(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS feed_last_updated " +
                "(subscription_id INTEGER NOT NULL, last_updated INTEGER, " +
                "PRIMARY KEY(subscription_id), " +
                "FOREIGN KEY(subscription_id) REFERENCES subscriptions(uid) " +
                "ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)"
        )
    }

        connection.execSQL("ALTER TABLE streams ADD COLUMN uploader_url TEXT")
    }

                " LEFT JOIN playlist_stream_join ps ON p.uid = ps.playlist_id" +
                " LEFT JOIN streams s ON s.uid = ps.stream_id" +
                " WHERE s.thumbnail_url = p.thumbnail_url) AS temporary_table" +

        )

                "SELECT `uid`, `name`, `is_thumbnail_permanent`, `thumbnail_stream_id`, " +

                "FROM `playlists`"

        connection.execSQL(

                "(`uid` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, " +

            "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `index_remote_playlists_service_id_url` " +
                "ON `remote_playlists` (`service_id`, `url`)"
        )
    }
